scope: Corollary 8.10 (A deterministic cap on the low scale) of the manuscript “The low-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick free-energy limiting law” (preprints/The-low-temperature-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-free-energy-limiting-law-September-24-2026/The-low-temperature-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-free-energy-limiting-law-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 217 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4acb0e456988f38e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 99. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For (D1) and the low statistics on size paths we may cap Y at xδ∗/3, decreasing p∗ if necessary, and still write Y = UZ. Indeed (D11) gives |Sv − q(v)|2 ≲ x2δ∗ , whereas on every bounded band x2δ∗ ≲ x4δ∗/3 /r2 . Thus the capped scale still satisfies (D1). Its new majorant Z = min(Zold, xδ∗/3/U) is at least one and no larger than the old majorant, so its fourth parameter moment is preserved.
